claim_boundary: No null is built, no mining radius is approved, no held-out result or scientific claim is produced, and no catalogue or event is signed by this audit. Original receipts and declarations remain unchanged. A failed discrimination criterion leaves T4E.8 and D97 open.

climatology_provenance.claim_boundary: climatology fit only; no cross-scale relationship or skill

design.acceptance_population: All repeated-key pairs, not just the selected stationary stratum, in each disjoint evaluation window. Both empirical error rates must meet the bounds. This is a necessary diagnostic, not sufficient scientific validation.
design.amendment_basis: After the first exploratory audit, add the monotone empirical feasibility diagnostic to distinguish a failed fixed radius from no feasible radius on these proxy populations. No threshold, window, weight or calibrated radius rule changes. This amendment uses already inspected data and is explicitly descriptive.
design.claim_boundary: No null is built, no mining radius is approved, no held-out result or scientific claim is produced, and no catalogue or event is signed by this audit. Original receipts and declarations remain unchanged. A failed discrimination criterion leaves T4E.8 and D97 open.
design.held_out_forecast_period: 2022-2023 is not opened by this audit. The evaluation windows are within the existing training split and share its train-fitted climatology; this is not independent confirmatory evidence.
design.labels: Equal sorted track_ids within one tracking window; all distinct observations of a repeated key. Different keys are proxy negatives, including keys sharing a track. Neither label class establishes physical identity or nonidentity.
design.legacy_clean_stratum: Stationary plus no change in the per-track band labels, retained for comparison to slice 1.
design.precision_reporting: Report pair counts and distinct contributing track keys; pairs are dependent. Report ceil(0.1*n) upper-tail observations rather than treating pair counts as independent sample sizes. Do not manufacture confidence bounds from iid binomial assumptions.
design.purpose: T4E.8 slice 2: evaluate a band- and strength-independent definition of spatial identity. This design is fixed before this candidate is measured; it is informed by slice 1 and is exploratory, not confirmatory.
design.radius_rule: Smallest observed stationary-pair distance admitting at least 90% of calibration-window stationary proxy repeats. Freeze that radius and apply unchanged in both evaluation windows. If no stationary pairs exist, publish NO_CALIBRATION_PAIRS and no radius.
design.signature_definition: Pairwise Euclidean separation in this record's parent-grid cells, plus admitted principal-axis bearings. Translation, rotation and reflection preserve the configuration; rescaling does not. Detector band scales and coefficient strengths are carried only. No scale-free two-node shape is claimed.
design.stationary_stratum: Exactly one observed cadence apart and maximum same-track displacement at most one parent-grid cell. No band condition is used for candidate calibration.
design.weights_basis: Keep the declared weights unchanged. The new signature has no comparable strength or scale block, so those weights have nothing to act on. No weight search is performed.

metric.block_reduction: root mean square within each block

component_distance.bearings: absolute folded-angle difference divided by 90 degrees
component_distance.scales: symmetric relative difference; absolute scales in scale-specific mode and geometric-mean-normalised ratios in scale-invariant mode

metric.metric_reduction: weighted root mean square over available positive-weight blocks
metric.node_correspondence: minimum over every node permutation (six at cardinality three); edge and node attributes move together under a permutation
